questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Uruguay?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uruguay article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Montevideo.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Uruguay?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Uruguay on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uruguay article.

questions.proof: Uruguay is bordered by two large neighbors, Brazil and Argentina.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The only country in South America that is smaller than Uruguay is _____.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Uruguay”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Uruguay article.

questions.proof: The only country in South America that is smaller than Uruguay is Suriname.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “In the north, a series of low mountains run north into the highlands of _____”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “highlands”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Uruguay article, under the heading “Geography”.

questions.proof: In the north, a series of low mountains run north into the highlands of Brazil
